title: Техническая
purpose: The bought shop's front page as its manager wrote it thirteen months ago: thin and out of date on Saturday hours and on who works the counter.
stale_on_purpose: S13/S2: Saturday hours and counter staff out of date
differs_from_en: STALE ON PURPOSE in two places, in the Russian form. (1) Hours: the page says 9:00 to 19:00; the company's hours are 9:00 to 20:00 at all three shops (the public page and shops/README.md). (2) The counter: names slot F1 (fired five months before T) and omits slots 24 and 28; team/who-is-who.md is right.
The broken link is the same: «Эвакуаторы, с которыми работаем» points to a page never written. Kazan's tow partner is stated nowhere.
Mechanics are named as the shop calls them (cast: Фарит абый, Виталик, Стас).
new_facts: The Kazan shop closed at 19:00 under its previous owner and has closed at 20:00 since the purchase. Reason: a Russian shop has no Saturday to be wrong about; an hour at the end of the day is the plausible stale fact. The ERP and the hours table show 20:00 at west.
